propositions: PASS-path plan review reuse (idempotent_reuse) synthesizes empty advisory/coaching/indeterminate lists instead of replaying stored findings from the last review's sidecar, causing loss of prior findings on reuse
BLOCK-path plan review reuse (verdict_reuse) already correctly replays stored blocking/advisory/coaching with reuse notation, establishing the desired behavior

CLI rendering does not distinguish that reused findings are the last review's result replayed against an unchanged plan, lacking recency context (verified_at_sha/timestamp) needed for staleness judgment

When plan fingerprint matches and attestation is valid, the returned verdict must populate advisory/coaching/indeterminate/coverage.counts from the stored REVIEW_RESULT sidecar while preserving fail-open degradation for absent or unreadable sidecars
